jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Operating Officer

Position Summary
The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is a senior executive responsible for overseeing the company's day-to-day operations, driving operational excellence, and ensuring that business activities are aligned with the organization's strategic objectives. This role works closely with the CEO and executive leadership team to translate corporate strategy into actionable operational plans, improve organizational performance, and support sustainable business growth.
The COO provides leadership across multiple business functions, including operations, business administration, process management, resource planning, and organizational development. This individual will establish effective operating structures, strengthen cross-functional collaboration, and ensure that the company maintains high standards of productivity, accountability, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
1. Executive Leadership & Strategic Planning
Lead the development and execution of company-wide operational strategies aligned with corporate objectives and long-term business priorities.
Work closely with the CEO and executive leadership team to establish strategic goals, operational priorities, and measurable performance targets.
Translate organizational strategies into actionable business plans, ensuring effective execution across departments and business units.
Provide executive guidance on operational decisions, organizational priorities, and opportunities for business improvement.
Monitor industry developments and business trends to identify operational opportunities, challenges, and potential areas for growth.
2. Daily Operations Management
Oversee daily business operations to ensure that organizational activities are conducted efficiently, consistently, and in accordance with established policies.
Establish operational procedures, management frameworks, and performance standards to support reliable business execution.
Monitor departmental activities and resolve operational challenges that may affect productivity, service delivery, or business continuity.
Ensure that operational resources, systems, and processes are effectively coordinated across the organization.
Promote a results-oriented operating environment that emphasizes efficiency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
3. Organizational Performance & Process Improvement
Evaluate existing business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce operational costs, and strengthen overall performance.
Develop and implement standardized operating procedures, workflow improvements, and internal management systems.
Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational effectiveness and assess progress against business objectives.
Analyze operational reports and performance data to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and areas requiring management attention.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity, operational quality, and organizational scalability.
4. Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
Coordinate with department heads and senior leaders to ensure alignment across finance, sales, marketing, human resources, technology, and other business functions.
Establish clear communication channels and accountability structures to support effective collaboration and decision-making.
Resolve cross-departmental challenges and ensure that shared business objectives remain a priority across all organizational units.
Support leadership teams in coordinating resources, managing dependencies, and delivering strategic initiatives.
Build a collaborative executive culture that encourages transparency, ownership, and consistent execution.
5. Financial & Resource Management
Work closely with the CFO and finance team to develop operational budgets, monitor expenditures, and maintain effective resource allocation.
Evaluate operational costs and identify opportunities to improve financial efficiency without compromising business quality.
Oversee resource planning to ensure that staffing, technology, facilities, and operational investments support organizational priorities.
Review financial and operational performance reports to assess efficiency, profitability, and resource utilization.
Ensure that operational decisions are consistent with approved budgets, financial objectives, and long-term business plans.
6. Risk Management & Operational Governance
Establish operational controls, policies, and governance procedures to support regulatory compliance and responsible business practices.
Identify potential operational risks and develop strategies to minimize disruptions and protect organizational resources.
Work with legal, compliance, finance, and other relevant departments to address regulatory requirements and internal control matters.
Oversee business continuity planning and ensure that appropriate procedures are in place to manage operational disruptions.
Promote a culture of accountability, ethical conduct, and compliance throughout the organization.
7. Business Growth & Organizational Development
Support the company's growth strategy by developing operational capabilities that can accommodate expanding business activities.
Evaluate opportunities to improve organizational structure, operational capacity, and management effectiveness.
Lead initiatives that strengthen internal systems, improve service delivery, and enhance the company's ability to scale.
Collaborate with executive leadership to assess new business opportunities, operational investments, and strategic initiatives.
Ensure that operational infrastructure and organizational resources are prepared to support future growth.
8. Leadership Development & Talent Management
Provide leadership and direction to senior managers, department heads, and operational teams across the organization.
Develop management structures, performance expectations, and leadership development initiatives to strengthen organizational capabilities.
Identify talent gaps and work with human resources to support recruitment, retention, succession planning, and employee development.
Establish clear performance management practices that promote accountability, professional growth, and consistent results.
Build a strong leadership culture focused on operational excellence, employee engagement, and long-term organizational success.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Management, Finance, or a related field required.
MBA or an advanced degree in Business Administration, Organizational Leadership, or a related discipline strongly preferred.
Additional executive education or professional development in corporate strategy, operational management, or organizational development is an advantage.
Experience
20+ years of progressive professional experience in business operations, general management, corporate administration, or organizational leadership.
10+ years of experience in senior management or executive leadership positions with responsibility for multiple business functions.
Demonstrated experience overseeing complex operational environments, managing cross-functional teams, and implementing company-wide business initiatives.
Strong background in operational strategy, process improvement, financial planning, organizational development, and performance management.
Proven ability to work closely with CEOs, executive leadership teams, and boards of directors to execute strategic business objectives.
Experience leading organizational transformation, business expansion, and operational scaling initiatives.

jobs.title: Director, Finance
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Reporting into the General Manager, the Director, Finance will partner with various functions of our business, providing timely financial insights in a collaborative environment. The Director, Finance will have direct influence and impact on the strategic financial decisions within the business unit, including pricing, new product feasibility, ongoing project profitability, quarterly forecasting, customer profitability and management reporting. This role leads a team of 2-3 direct reports, providing mentorship, direction and day-to-day leadership for the finance function.

This position is right for you if you are strategic, action-oriented, challenge the status quo, highly analytical, results-driven, have a high level of energy, have high attention to detail, and can communicate clearly and concisely. As a member of the leadership team, you will be highly visible, partnering with all areas of the business, you will share a passion for developing talent with a focus on building sustained long-term growth and creating a fantastic place to work.

Job Description

Minimum Base Salary:
$160,000

Maximum Base Salary:
$170,000

Responsibilities

Direct oversight of accounting operations, transactions, and internal controls (including but not limited to record to report, order to cash and procure to pay)
Oversee the month end processes, reconciliations and internal reporting to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, including reviewing and producing period end variance reports and commentary
Maintains a documented system of accounting policies and procedures; implements a system of controls over accounting transactions to minimize risk.
Oversee the Percentage of Completion method to recognize revenue based on work performed, aligning revenue with actual costs incurred, efforts expended, or physical milestones achieved.
Accountable for accurate and timely monthly/quarterly financial reporting to ensure compliance with internal and external reporting (in accordance with IFRS)
Coordinate, analyze and present the monthly financial performance to the Executive Team, Senior Management and Modaxo
Own the quarterly financial forecasting process (“QSR”), including but not limited to: consideration of the sales pipeline, costs analysis (COGS and OPEX), and key drivers and assumptions.
Govern, with the support of the General Manger, execution of action plans from the QSR review process  
Provide leadership, guidance and coaching to direct reports, ensuring continual development, performance expectations and engagement, performance reviews and goal setting, and fostering a collaborative team environment
Lead financial analysis over any new product initiatives which would include cost assessment, revenue forecasts and overall lifetime profitability
Responsible for working with the business to assess market pricing, new deal pricing, and sales approach for our products.
Monitor and input on key metrics of individual customer contracts 
Monitor and enforce Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
Provide corporate tax support; transfer pricing, and state revenue allocations
Coordinate, analyze and report the financial performance to the Leadership Team and the Modaxo Team (Group(s) > Portfolio > Global).
Become an expert in the company’s forecasting tool, Adaptive Planning, and knowledgeable in the company’s other key tools such as OpenAir (PSA), SalesForce (CRM) and Great Plains/NetSuite (ERP).
Work closely with all functional leads to ensure projects bids and contract terms, financial and otherwise, adhere to corporate parameters 

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Management or a related field.
Professional accounting designation (CPA, CMA, or CA)
Minimum of 10+ years accounting and/or finance experience, minimum 5 years in a management role within Finance

Qualifications

Excellent with Microsoft Excel
Experience in Adaptive Planning, OpenAir, NetSuite, PowerBI a plus
Familiarity with AI-driven automation tools (e.g., FloQast, BlackLine, or ERP AI integrations)
Ability to perform under pressure and meet deadlines
High integrity and personal ethics due to sensitive issues and information this role entails
Desire to improve processes and systems rather than just keep the status quo
Strong communication skills to work across time zones and cultural differences
Well organized, detail-oriented and able to work variable hours when required
Desire to support a culture of continuous learning
Energetic, personable and results oriented
A “can-do” attitude taking ownership; prepared to be held accountable for actions, behaviors and targets
North American travel will be required (up to 25%).

In the USA, this job profile is EXEMPT
and will be not eligible for paid overtime. If you are unsure of what job profile to choose please contact your HR Partner.

jobs.title: Human Resources Director
jobs.description:
An employer is seeking a Director, Global People Operations to lead HR and people operations across multiple regions and support a fast-scaling workforce. This role will own the global people operations function, systems, and distributed team while partnering with leadership on strategic talent and organizational initiatives.

The Role

• Lead and scale the global people operations function, setting consistent operating standards and managing a distributed team across multiple regions and time zones.
• Oversee day-to-day service delivery across regions, encompassing HRIS, people systems, onboarding, offboarding, and the full employee lifecycle with modern process automation.
• Manage multi-region compliance, statutory requirements, and complex employee relations, serving as a senior escalation point for investigations and risk mitigation.
• Partner with senior leadership to provide insight-led guidance on organizational design, workforce planning, change management, and talent strategy.
• Own the design, governance, and scaling of global compensation, performance frameworks, benefits, and people programs.

What You'll Need

• 12 to 15+ years of progressive HR and people operations experience within multi-country, high-growth technology environments.
• 7+ years of people leadership managing and developing HR teams across multiple regions and time zones.
• Demonstrated expertise in multi-region compliance, employment law, and global operational ownership.
• Bachelor's degree required, with strong strategic business partnering and systems-oriented backgrounds.

What's On Offer

• Annual salary of CA$167,000 - CA$243,000
• Annual bonus and equity on top of base salary
• Benefits package and a remote role leading a distributed team
